long_biography.plain_text:
At Invus, Raymond “Ray” Debbane built an unusually patient investment model around permanent capital. A management-consulting assignment for a Belgian sugar family led to the firm’s creation and gave Debbane responsibility for both private acquisitions and the family’s liquid assets. The structure removed the usual pressure to sell businesses quickly.

Debbane backed turnarounds at Keebler, Weight Watchers and Blue Buffalo, using product strategy, management changes and sustained marketing investment rather than rapid financial exits. His move from agricultural engineering and food science into consulting remained visible in the consumer businesses he selected, while Invus also developed substantial biotechnology and public-equity programmes.

uncertainties.detail: The input stores Raymond Joseph Nicolas F. Debbane Adjoury. Invus Asia data expands the initial as Francois and spells the final element Adjouri, while Cyprus records use Raymond Joseph Nicolas Debbane and public corporate sources use Raymond or Ray Debbane. The identity chain is secure, but the y/i transliteration and exact component split are not strong enough for a display-name or component-field correction.

Current Companies House and SEC records confirm Panamanian nationality or citizenship, and strong reporting establishes birth in Lebanon. They do not establish whether he currently holds Lebanese citizenship in addition to his Lebanese birth and background. The existing primary Lebanese and secondary Panamamian values are therefore left unchanged rather than conflating birthplace with citizenship.

The capital managed by Invus belongs to Artal and the Wittouck family. Debbane co-founded and runs the adviser and has earned a share of investment profits, but public sources do not support treating the full Artal portfolio or the Wittouck family fortune as his personal property.

The investment-management and profit-participation mechanism is well documented, and no source indicates inheritance of the core assets. His father's academic role is public, but the wider family-wealth and network position at launch is not sufficiently documented for either self-made subtype, so broad Self-made is retained.

Strong sources establish Lebanon as the birth country and March 1955 as the month and year, which are already present in the input. No strong source supplied an exact city or day, so the two blank fields remain unproposed.

The official Invus biography directly verifies one personal LinkedIn URL and the company website. No personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or standalone personal website met the identity-verification threshold.
